title: Postdoc.Mobility
about: SNSF Postdoc.Mobility fellowship, February 2027 call, supporting early-career researchers linked to Switzerland in a research stay abroad. Submission via mySNF. The scheme is being replaced; its final call closes in August 2027.
requirements: Proposals no earlier than 6 months before the thesis defence
Non-Swiss applicants without a Swiss settlement permit generally need a Swiss doctorate or state examination and no prior postdoc abroad

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: Field "All research disciplines" / seniority "Early postdoctoral researchers" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

Research stay abroad ("supporting early-career researchers linked to Switzerland in a research stay abroad") → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
Note: the record's listed qualifications are eligibility rules (thesis timing, Swiss doctorate), which no course covers; the match is to the research work the fellowship funds.
